summary: The AssessmentValidationResult class is a sealed class that contains boolean properties used for validation purposes in assessments.
purpose: To provide a structured way to represent validation results of assessments through boolean properties indicating different validation conditions.

validations.name: InterimWithoutFinal
validations.description: Boolean indicating whether an interim status is allowed without a final assessment.

validations.name: InstructorsAndSupervisors
validations.description: Boolean indicating the involvement of both instructors and supervisors in the assessment process.

validations.name: AssessmentMaximumExceeded
validations.description: Boolean indicating whether the maximum allowable assessments have been exceeded.
